task_context.problem_statement: George donated half his monthly income to charity and spent $20 from the other half on groceries. If he now has $100 left, how much was his monthly income?
task_context.reference_solution:
Half his monthly income is $100+$20 = $<<100+20=120>>120
His monthly income therefore is 2*$120 = $<<2*120=240>>240
#### 240
